# Commerce Functions 2.0.0-local.1

Ordinary programs in Contracts/Compute Definition, executed under the imported Contracts/BEX profile. No new native protocol, no new SDK. `Totals` computes an exact integer product plus an explicitly required fee.

The 1.1 release adds an independent export while preserving Totals. The 2.0 release changes function arguments but still uses the same BEX. Every name is resolved under this package’s own imports.
